name: Sentora x Spark RLUSD
oneLiner: sxsRLUSD is Sentora and Spark's RLUSD vault on Morpho; shares hold idle RLUSD and WBTC-backed loans, with withdrawals subject to liquidity.
collateral: RLUSD held idle in an immutable Morpho Vault V2 and supplied by a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 to a WBTC-collateralized lending market. Allocations can change under curator controls.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares convert to RLUSD at the live assets-per-share rate. Interest, fees and recognized losses change share value. At the pinned review liquidityAdapter() is zero, so ordinary withdrawals use idle RLUSD; force-deallocation is separate and depends on market liquidity. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0.01% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

The sole market lends RLUSD against WBTC at 86% LLTV; the adapter has no borrow shares or posted collateral. convertToAssets(1e18) returns 1000075796110981091 raw RLUSD. Deposit/mint requires assets; fees accrue as shares and recognized lending losses reduce NAV.
